chunks: Safwan ibn Yahya narrated from Musa ibn Bakr from Zurara from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
"A girl is not entered into (consummated) until she reaches nine years or ten years."

key_terms.يُدْخَلُ: Is entered into (referring to marital consummation)

ai.seo_question: What is the age of puberty for girls according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Reported by the prominent jurist Zurara from Imam al-Baqir, this hadith establishes the minimum age for marital consummation (dakhil) at nine or ten years, reflecting the classical Shia view of physical and mental maturity. It serves as a foundational text in the chapter on guardianship, linking the legal capacity of the minor to the authority of the father or guardian in arranging marriage.
